change_fjord: Fjord itself does something for the user, without any session: turn a setting on or off, including its notifications; change Triage's inbox categories, rules or groups; mark a Router card the user has seen or read as seen (a worth-a-look card: "seen the docs", "got it", "I read the headlines"); mark things in the inbox as done or seen. Not asking a session to build or change code, and not a message for a session to act on (an instruction or a reply addressed to it, even one that mentions what the user has seen)
gate_setting: Does `message` ask Fjord itself to do something for the user, without any session: turn a setting on or off, including its notifications; change Triage's inbox categories, rules or groups; mark a Router card the user has seen or read as seen (a worth-a-look card: "seen the docs", "got it", "I read the headlines"); mark things in the inbox as done or seen? Not code to be written, and not a message for a session to do or answer something.
